title: מדדי ההשוואה לפי הוראה 451
note: Three fictional banks with invented rates, three invented forecasts (not the Bank of Israel's), and a fictional borrower couple. The measures follow the team's transcription of Directive 451 appendix 4, not checked against the directive: the expected total rate is lesson 3.10's actual cost of credit, the monthly IRR of all forecast payments against the loan less the up-front charges, compounded to a year; the total is the sum of the forecast payments; the highest is the highest forecast payment (first month it appears). Schedules follow the statement convention; the IRR is found by bisection (TypeScript) and Newton's method (Python). Which charges count as up-front charges is an open legal question.
